## 1. Identity & Core Value Proposition
Kumar Utkarsh is a Senior Business Analyst, AI Product Strategist, and Project Manager with 6+ years of experience delivering 700+ web applications, mobile platforms, and enterprise software systems across 34 global client markets. By replacing ambiguous static text specifications with interactive, multi-role HTML "Living Specifications" before sprint kickoff, his methodology achieves a measured 35%+ reduction in post-launch engineering rework and maintains a 98% positive client satisfaction rating.
